title: Fusion Power Explained – Future or Failure
speaker: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
zh: 【Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell】聚變發電的解釋－未來或失敗（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: The fundamental currency of our universe is energy.
cues.en: The fundamental currency of our universe is energy.
cues.zh: 我們宇宙的基礎貨幣是能量

cues.text: It lights our homes, grows our food, powers our computers.
cues.en: It lights our homes, grows our food, powers our computers.
cues.zh: 能量可以點亮我們的家、生長食物、讓我們的電腦運作

cues.text: We can get it lots of ways: Burning fossil fuels, splitting atoms,
cues.en: We can get it lots of ways: Burning fossil fuels, splitting atoms,
cues.zh: 有很多有很多方式可以獲得能量： 燃燒化石燃料、分裂原子、

cues.text: or sunlight striking photovoltaics.
cues.en: or sunlight striking photovoltaics.
cues.zh: 或是太陽能發電

cues.text: But there's a downside to everything Fossil fuels are extremely toxic,
cues.en: But there's a downside to everything Fossil fuels are extremely toxic,
cues.zh: 但每種方法都有缺點 化石燃料會極度汙染

cues.text: Nuclear waste is... well, nuclear waste, And, there are not enough batteries to store sunlight for cloudy days yet.
cues.en: Nuclear waste is... well, nuclear waste, And, there are not enough batteries to store sunlight for cloudy days yet.
cues.zh: 核廢料…嗯，就是核廢料 而且，現在還沒有足夠的電池 可以儲存足夠的陽光給陰天的時候用呢

cues.text: And yet the sun seems to have virtually limitless free energy.
cues.en: And yet the sun seems to have virtually limitless free energy.
cues.zh: 然而，太陽似乎有幾乎無限的免費能量

cues.text: Is there a way we could build a sun on Earth?
cues.en: Is there a way we could build a sun on Earth?
cues.zh: 有沒有辦法在地球上製造一顆太陽呢？

cues.text: Can we bottle a star?
cues.en: Can we bottle a star?
cues.zh: 我們能否把星星裝進瓶子裡？

cues.text: The sun shines because of nuclear fusion.
cues.en: The sun shines because of nuclear fusion.
cues.zh: 太陽的光來自核融合。

cues.text: In a nutshell, fusion is a thermonuclear process.
cues.en: In a nutshell, fusion is a thermonuclear process.
cues.zh: 簡而言之，核融合是一種熱核融合反應

cues.text: Meaning that the ingredients have to be incredibly hot.
cues.en: Meaning that the ingredients have to be incredibly hot.
cues.zh: 這意味著材料一定要熱得不得了

cues.text: So hot, that the atoms are stripped of their electrons Making a plasma where nuclei and electrons bounce around freely.
cues.en: So hot, that the atoms are stripped of their electrons Making a plasma where nuclei and electrons bounce around freely.
cues.zh: 熱到讓原子上的電子離家出走 他們就變成電漿了，在電漿裡 原子核和電子會自由地彈跳

cues.text: Since nuclei are all positively charged, They repel each other.
cues.en: Since nuclei are all positively charged, They repel each other.
cues.zh: 由於原子核都帶正電， 它們之間會相互排斥

cues.text: In order to overcome this repulsion, The particles have to be going very, very fast
cues.en: In order to overcome this repulsion, The particles have to be going very, very fast
cues.zh: 要克服這個斥力 該粒子必須動的非常非常快

cues.text: In this context, very fast means "very hot" Millions of degrees
cues.en: In this context, very fast means "very hot" Millions of degrees
cues.zh: 在這種情況下，非常快的意思是「非常熱」 好幾百萬度

cues.text: Stars cheat to reach these temperatures.
cues.en: Stars cheat to reach these temperatures.
cues.zh: 星星會作弊來達到這些溫度

cues.text: They are so massive, that the pressure in their cores Generates the heat to squeeze the nuclei together
cues.en: They are so massive, that the pressure in their cores Generates the heat to squeeze the nuclei together
cues.zh: 他們是如此龐大，在他們核心裡的壓力 產生的熱會把原子核擠成一團

cues.text: Until they merge and fuse Creating heavier nuclei and releasing energy in the process.
cues.en: Until they merge and fuse Creating heavier nuclei and releasing energy in the process.
cues.zh: 然後他們就融合在一起了 這樣會創造出較重的原子核，並在過程中釋放能量

cues.text: It is this energy release that scientists hope to harness
cues.en: It is this energy release that scientists hope to harness
cues.zh: 科學家想要採集的正是這種能量的釋放

cues.text: In a new generation of power plant, The fusion reactor.
cues.en: In a new generation of power plant, The fusion reactor.
cues.zh: 就在新型的發電廠 也就是核融合反應爐裡

cues.text: On earth it's not feasible to use this brute force method to create fusion.
cues.en: On earth it's not feasible to use this brute force method to create fusion.
cues.zh: 在地球上，像太陽一樣使用暴力來產生融合是不可行的

cues.text: So if we wanted to build a reactor that generates energy from fusion, We have to get clever.
cues.en: So if we wanted to build a reactor that generates energy from fusion, We have to get clever.
cues.zh: 因此，如果我們想建立從核融合產生能量的反應爐 我們就要略施小計

cues.text: To date, scientists have invented two ways of making plasmas hot enough to fuse:
cues.en: To date, scientists have invented two ways of making plasmas hot enough to fuse:
cues.zh: 迄今為止，科學家已經發明瞭兩種 使電漿熱到足以產生融合的方式

cues.text: The first type of reactor uses a magnetic field to Squeeze a plasma in a doughnut shaped chamber
cues.en: The first type of reactor uses a magnetic field to Squeeze a plasma in a doughnut shaped chamber
cues.zh: 第一型別的反應爐的使用磁場來 把電漿擠壓在甜甜圈形狀的空間裡

cues.text: Where the reactions take place.
cues.en: Where the reactions take place.
cues.zh: 這裡面就會發生核反應

cues.text: These magnetic confinement reactors Such as the I.T.E.R. reactor in France,
cues.en: These magnetic confinement reactors Such as the I.T.E.R. reactor in France,
cues.zh: 這些磁力可以約束反應爐 如法國的 I.T.E.R 反應爐

cues.text: Use superconducting electromagnets cooled with liquid helium To within a few degrees of absolute zero.
cues.en: Use superconducting electromagnets cooled with liquid helium To within a few degrees of absolute zero.
cues.zh: 透過液態氦冷卻的超導體電磁鐵 使其溫度被降到離絕對零度不到幾度

cues.text: Meaning that they host some of the biggest temperature gradients in the known universe.
cues.en: Meaning that they host some of the biggest temperature gradients in the known universe.
cues.zh: 這意味著裡面有已知的宇宙裡 最大的溫差

cues.text: The second type called "Inertial confinement" Uses pulses from super-powered lasers
cues.en: The second type called "Inertial confinement" Uses pulses from super-powered lasers
cues.zh: 第二類被稱為「慣性約束」 使用超高能的雷射的脈衝

cues.text: To heat the surface of a pellet of fuel Imploding it, briefly making the fuel hot and dense enough to fuse.
cues.en: To heat the surface of a pellet of fuel Imploding it, briefly making the fuel hot and dense enough to fuse.
cues.zh: 來加熱燃料丸的表面 使其內爆，短暫使燃料夠熱、夠密到足以產生融合

cues.text: In fact, one of the of the most powerful lasers in the world Is used for fusion experiments
cues.en: In fact, one of the of the most powerful lasers in the world Is used for fusion experiments
cues.zh: 事實上，世界上最強大的雷射之一 正是用於核融合實驗

cues.text: At the National Ignition Facility in the U.S.
cues.en: At the National Ignition Facility in the U.S.
cues.zh: 它位在美國的國家點火設施

cues.text: These experiments and others like them around the world are today, just experiments.
cues.en: These experiments and others like them around the world are today, just experiments.
cues.zh: 這些實驗以及其他世界各地的類似設施 到目前為止都還只是實驗

cues.text: Scientists are still developing the technology, And although they can achieve fusion,
cues.en: Scientists are still developing the technology, And although they can achieve fusion,
cues.zh: 科學家們仍在開發這項科技， 雖然他們可以實現融合

cues.text: Right now, it costs more energy to do the experiment Then they produce in fusion.
cues.en: Right now, it costs more energy to do the experiment Then they produce in fusion.
cues.zh: 目前，做這實驗要花的電 比核融合產生的電還多

cues.text: The technology has a long way to go before it's commercially viable,
cues.en: The technology has a long way to go before it's commercially viable,
cues.zh: 在有商業價值之前，這項科技還有很長的路要走

cues.text: and maybe it never will be.
cues.en: and maybe it never will be.
cues.zh: 也許這永遠不會成功

cues.text: It might just be impossible to make a viable fusion reactor on earth,
cues.en: It might just be impossible to make a viable fusion reactor on earth,
cues.zh: 也許在地球上建造一個可行的核融合反應爐是不可能的

cues.text: But if it gets there, it will be so efficient That a single glass of sea water, could be used to produce
cues.en: But if it gets there, it will be so efficient That a single glass of sea water, could be used to produce
cues.zh: 但如果我們做到了，它的效能會非常高 一杯海水就可以產生

cues.text: as much energy as burning a barrel of oil, with no waste to speak of.
cues.en: as much energy as burning a barrel of oil, with no waste to speak of.
cues.zh: 跟一桶油一樣多的能量，而且不會產生廢氣

cues.text: This is because fusion reactors would use hydrogen or helium as fuel
cues.en: This is because fusion reactors would use hydrogen or helium as fuel
cues.zh: 這是因為核融合反應爐 將使用氫或氦作為燃料

cues.text: And sea water is loaded with hydrogen But not just any hydrogen will do.
cues.en: And sea water is loaded with hydrogen But not just any hydrogen will do.
cues.zh: 而海水有滿滿的氫 但不是任何的氫都可以用

cues.text: Specific isotopes with extra neutrons called Deuterium and Tritium
cues.en: Specific isotopes with extra neutrons called Deuterium and Tritium
cues.zh: 必須使用具備額外中子的氫同位素 就是所謂的氘和氚

cues.text: Are needed to make the right reactions.
cues.en: Are needed to make the right reactions.
cues.zh: 才能產生正確的反應

cues.text: Deuterium is stable and can be found in abundance in sea water,
cues.en: Deuterium is stable and can be found in abundance in sea water,
cues.zh: 氘是穩定的 在海水裡就可以找到很多

cues.text: Though Tritium is a bit trickier.
cues.en: Though Tritium is a bit trickier.
cues.zh: 不過氚有點難對付

cues.text: It's radioactive And there may only be 20 kilograms of it in the world
cues.en: It's radioactive And there may only be 20 kilograms of it in the world
cues.zh: 它有放射性 並且全球可能只有20公斤的氚

cues.text: Mostly in nuclear warheads Which makes it incredibly expensive.
cues.en: Mostly in nuclear warheads Which makes it incredibly expensive.
cues.zh: 大多在核彈頭裡 所以它非常昂貴

cues.text: So we made need another fusion buddy for Deuterium instead of Tritium.
cues.en: So we made need another fusion buddy for Deuterium instead of Tritium.
cues.zh: 因此，我們需要氘的核融合好友 我們不用氚

cues.text: Helium-3, an isotope of Helium, might be a great substitute.
cues.en: Helium-3, an isotope of Helium, might be a great substitute.
cues.zh: 而是用氦的同位素，氦-3 它可能是一個很棒的替代品

cues.text: Unfortunately, it's also incredibly rare on earth.
cues.en: Unfortunately, it's also incredibly rare on earth.
cues.zh: 不幸的是，它在地球上極其稀少

cues.text: But here, the moon might have the answer.
cues.en: But here, the moon might have the answer.
cues.zh: 但在月球這裡可能有答案

cues.text: Over billions of years, the solar wind may have built up huge deposits
cues.en: Over billions of years, the solar wind may have built up huge deposits
cues.zh: 幾十億年間 太陽風可能已經在月球上堆滿了

cues.text: Of Helium-3 on the moon.
cues.en: Of Helium-3 on the moon.
cues.zh: 太陽風可能已經在月球上堆滿了 大量的氦-3

cues.text: Instead of making Helium-3, we can mine it.
cues.en: Instead of making Helium-3, we can mine it.
cues.zh: 我們不用親自生產氦-3，我們可以去挖掘它

cues.text: If we could sift the lunar dust for helium, We'd have enough fuel to power the entire world for thousands of years.
cues.en: If we could sift the lunar dust for helium, We'd have enough fuel to power the entire world for thousands of years.
cues.zh: 如果我們可以把月球塵埃過篩，尋找氦 那我們就會有足夠的燃料讓全世界使用幾千年

cues.text: One more argument for establishing a moon base, if you weren't convinced already.
cues.en: One more argument for establishing a moon base, if you weren't convinced already.
cues.zh: 如果你不支援月球基地的話 這是建立月球基地的又一個理由

cues.text: Ok, maybe you think building a mini sun Still sound kind of dangerous
cues.en: Ok, maybe you think building a mini sun Still sound kind of dangerous
cues.zh: 好吧，也許你認為製造一個小型太陽 聽起來有點危險

cues.text: But they'd actually be much safer than most other types of powerplants A fusion reactor is not like a nuclear plant,
cues.en: But they'd actually be much safer than most other types of powerplants A fusion reactor is not like a nuclear plant,
cues.zh: 但他們實際上比大多數其他型別的發電廠更安全 核融合反應爐並不像普通的核電廠，

cues.text: Which can melt down catastrophically.
cues.en: Which can melt down catastrophically.
cues.zh: 它不會災難性的融解

cues.text: If the confinement failed, then the plasma would expand and cool,
cues.en: If the confinement failed, then the plasma would expand and cool,
cues.zh: 如果約束失敗了，那麼裡面的電漿將擴大並冷卻

cues.text: And the reaction would stop.
cues.en: And the reaction would stop.
cues.zh: 導致核反應停止

cues.text: Put simply, it's not a bomb.
cues.en: Put simply, it's not a bomb.
cues.zh: 簡單地說，它不會變成炸彈

cues.text: The release of radioactive fuel, like Tritium, Could pose a threat to the environment.
cues.en: The release of radioactive fuel, like Tritium, Could pose a threat to the environment.
cues.zh: 放射性燃料的釋放，比如說氚 可能對環境造成威脅

cues.text: Tritium could bond with oxygen making radioactive water, Which could be dangerous as it seeps into the environment.
cues.en: Tritium could bond with oxygen making radioactive water, Which could be dangerous as it seeps into the environment.
cues.zh: 氚可以與和氧結合，產生有放射性的水 這可能是危險的，因為它會滲透到環境裡

cues.text: Fortunately, there's no more than a few grams in use at a given time,
cues.en: Fortunately, there's no more than a few grams in use at a given time,
cues.zh: 幸運的是，我們每次使用的量 不會超過幾公克，所以洩漏物很快會被稀釋掉

cues.text: So a leak would be quickly diluted.
cues.en: So a leak would be quickly diluted.
cues.zh: 不會超過幾公克，所以洩漏物很快會被稀釋掉

cues.text: So we've just told you that theres nearly unlimited energy to be had At no expense to the environment
cues.en: So we've just told you that theres nearly unlimited energy to be had At no expense to the environment
cues.zh: 所以，我們剛告訴你世界上有幾乎無限的能量 又不必犧牲環境

cues.text: In something as simple as water.
cues.en: In something as simple as water.
cues.zh: 就存在在水裡

cues.text: So, whats the catch?
cues.en: So, whats the catch?
cues.zh: 那麼，我們為什麼不用？

cues.text: Cost. We simply don't know if fusion power will ever be commercially viable.
cues.en: Cost. We simply don't know if fusion power will ever be commercially viable.
cues.zh: 答案是成本。我們根本不知道核融合 有沒有商業價值

cues.text: Even if they work, they might be too expensive to ever build.
cues.en: Even if they work, they might be too expensive to ever build.
cues.zh: 即使有可能建造，它們可能貴到蓋不出來

cues.text: The main drawback, is that it's unproven technology Its a 10 billion dollar gamble
cues.en: The main drawback, is that it's unproven technology Its a 10 billion dollar gamble
cues.zh: 它的主要缺點是，它是未經驗證的技術 它是百億美元的豪賭 而這些錢用在其他 已經證實可行的乾淨能源上

cues.text: And that money might be better spent on other clean energy That's already proven itself.
cues.en: And that money might be better spent on other clean energy That's already proven itself.
cues.zh: 而這些錢用在其他 已經證實可行的乾淨能源上 可能會更好

cues.text: Maybe we should cut out losses Or maybe, when the payoff is unlimited clean energy for everyone,
cues.en: Maybe we should cut out losses Or maybe, when the payoff is unlimited clean energy for everyone,
cues.zh: 也許我們應該現在收手不幹 又或許，當成果可以讓每個人 享有無限乾淨能源時

cues.text: It might be worth the risk.
cues.en: It might be worth the risk.
cues.zh: 這可能是值得冒險的

cues.en: Videos like this one take hundreds of hours to make and are made possible by your contributions on patreon.com
cues.zh: 像這樣的影片要花費數百個小時製作 全都靠大家在 patreon.com 上的貢獻才能完成

cues.text: If you want to learn more about global energy, Here's a playlist about nuclear energy, fracking and solar power.
cues.en: If you want to learn more about global energy, Here's a playlist about nuclear energy, fracking and solar power.
cues.zh: 如果您想了解更多有關全球能源的議題 這裡有一個關於核能，水力裂解 和太陽能發電的播放列表

cues.text: Let us know in the comments if there are other technologies you want us to explain.
cues.en: Let us know in the comments if there are other technologies you want us to explain.
cues.zh: 如果有其他科技是你要我們講解的 請在底下留言
